hover-tint.$description: The ground of whatever the pointer is over, in the accent's hue (rule 21). A button, a row, a menu entry and a tile all take this one colour, so two things lit side by side never differ. It sits a small step darker than surface3, which lifts a row off the card and a quiet button off surface2 while the text and the secondary text on it keep 4.5:1. The chroma is a share of the accent's own, so a grey accent leaves surface3's grey. Declared again inside a rainbow position, so the hover takes the position's hue there, and in reactive mode only once the position lights up.

modes.name: oled
modes.$description: OLED moves surface3 one stone step down, and the hover with it.

hover-chroma.$description: How much of the accent's chroma the hover takes.

org.glimstone.tailwindNote: The accent's hover (rule 21): hover:bg-hover on anything the pointer can reach, a button, a row, a menu entry or a tile.

hover-raised.$description: The same hover for a control that rests on surface3, such as the neutral button or a segment in its groove, where --hover would sit within a hair of the fill. It stands a step further from surface3, lighter on the dark ramps and darker on the light one, and the text and the secondary text keep 4.5:1 on it.

org.glimstone.tailwindNote: The hover of a control that rests on surface3: hover:bg-hoverRaised.
